gaps.why: No project transformer schedule found: MVA rating, 132/11 kV or 11/0.433 kV allocation, impedance, tap range, cooling class, quantity-by-duty or SESB-approved vendor list for these four units is not stated in any source read.
gaps.next_action: Obtain the four transformer datasheets and the SESB approval letters; do not infer MVA from the seven-engine plant rating.

gaps.why: No printed price, year or currency for these four transformers was found; the RM230 million figure in The Edge is a whole 72 MW EPCC award, not a transformer line-item price.
gaps.next_action: Record the line-item BOQ rate with its printed year and currency when available.

gaps.why: No patents on transformer design were read from a patent page; the IEC 60076-1 foreword only warns that some elements may be subject to patent rights.
gaps.next_action: Leave patents empty until a specific patent page is read.

notes: Analysed core item from the owner-supplied equipment/facilities list for a 7-unit gas-engine power plant. Evidence categories present: sources, specifications, vendors, catalogue models. Checked for prices, projects, standards, patents, drawings and materials; where absent the gaps record says so.
